mechanism: Both agents are antihypertensives with additive effects on blood pressure and heart rate reduction; guanfacine is an alpha-2 agonist and atenolol is a beta-blocker, and concurrent use may potentiate hypotension and bradycardia.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate closely; dose adjustments may be necessary; educate patient on symptoms of hypotension and bradycardia such as dizziness, fatigue, or syncope.
